Based on the image provided, here are the precise answers to your questions:

(1) **Audio Controls:** The visible audio controls are **VOICE** and **MUSIC** (presented as toggle pills). There is also a **settings/gear icon** to the right of these controls.

(2) **Status Line Text:** The small status line under the controls says: **"Narrating — music lowers while I speak."**

(3) **Readability:** **Yes**, the tour step title ("One stream becomes two") and the descriptive text ("The delivery arrives...") are fully readable and clearly legible.

(4) **Visual Defects:** **No**, there are no visual defects. The text is well-spaced, elements are properly aligned within the panel, and nothing appears clipped or overlapping.

(5) **Flowsheet Canvas Integrity:** The flowsheet canvas looks **partially intact** based on what is visible. It shows a single frame, **2 equipment symbols** (F-101 Syngas Feed and E-101 Chiller), and **1 stream pill** (labeled "1"). (Note: While the header mentions "3 units" and "4 streams", only two units and one stream are currently rendered in the visible viewport of the canvas).
